options.name: sccp
options.description: EXPERTS ONLY! KNOWLEDGE OF FMGR JSON API IS REQUIRED! List of multiple child objects to be added. Expects a list of dictionaries. Dictionaries must use FortiManager API parameters, not the ansible ones listed below. If submitted, all other prefixed sub-parameters ARE IGNORED. This object is MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with its options. We expect that you know what you are doing with these list parameters, and are leveraging the JSON API Guide. WHEN IN DOUBT, USE THE SUB OPTIONS BELOW INSTEAD TO CREATE OB

options.name: sccp_block_mcast

options.name: sip_ssl_algorithm
options.description: Relative strength of encryption algorithms accepted in negotiation. choice | high | High encryption. Allow only AES and ChaCha. choice | medium | Medium encryption. Allow AES, ChaCha, 3DES, and RC4. choice | low | Low encryption. Allow AES, ChaCha, 3DES, RC4, and DES.

options.name: sip_ssl_auth_client
options.description: Require a client certificate and authenticate it with the peer/peergrp.

options.name: sip_ssl_auth_server
options.description: Authenticate the server's certificate with the peer/peergrp.

options.name: sip_ssl_client_certificate
options.description: Name of Certificate to offer to server if requested.

options.name: sip_ssl_client_renegotiation
options.description: Allow/block client renegotiation by server. choice | allow | Allow a SSL client to renegotiate. choice | deny | Abort any SSL connection that attempts to renegotiate. choice | secure | Reject any SSL connection that does not offer a RFC 5746 Secure Renegotiation Indication.

options.name: sip_ssl_max_version
options.description: Highest SSL/TLS version to negotiate. choice | ssl-3.0 | SSL 3.0. choice | tls-1.0 | TLS 1.0. choice | tls-1.1 | TLS 1.1. choice | tls-1.2 | TLS 1.2.

options.name: sip_ssl_min_version
options.description: Lowest SSL/TLS version to negotiate. choice | ssl-3.0 | SSL 3.0. choice | tls-1.0 | TLS 1.0. choice | tls-1.1 | TLS 1.1. choice | tls-1.2 | TLS 1.2.

options.name: sip_ssl_mode
options.description: SSL/TLS mode for encryption & decryption of traffic. choice | off | No SSL. choice | full | Client to FortiGate and FortiGate to Server SSL.

options.name: sip_ssl_pfs
options.description: SSL Perfect Forward Secrecy. choice | require | PFS mandatory. choice | deny | PFS rejected. choice | allow | PFS allowed.

options.name: sip_ssl_send_empty_frags
options.description: Send empty fragments to avoid attack on CBC IV (SSL 3.0 & TLS 1.0 only). choice | disable | Do not send empty fragments. choice | enable | Send empty fragments.

options.name: sip_ssl_server_certificate
options.description: Name of Certificate return to the client in every SSL connection.

options.name: sip_status
options.description: Enable/disable SIP. choice | disable | Disable status. choice | enable | Enable status.

options.name: sip_strict_register
options.description: Enable/disable only allow the registrar to connect. choice | disable | Disable status. choice | enable | Enable status.
